gloss: The logic function exclusive OR (as opposed to inclusive OR), whose output is true only when exactly one of its inputs is true.
The connective "exclusive or". One way to state its meaning in plain English is "if either A or B, but not if both."
A logic gate that implements "exclusive or".
The symbolic representation that implements "exclusive or".
A wooden statue used as a cult image in Ancient Greece.
A spicy sauce from Hong Kong, made from roughly chopped dried seafood, chili peppers, onions, and garlic.
